nvidia_openshell.name: NVIDIA OpenShell
nvidia_openshell.description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
nvidia_openshell.csoai_wedge: Treat OpenShell as a confinement substrate and a measurement target, not a Council OS replacement.
nvidia_openshell.csoai_relevance: High. OpenShell provides agent confinement; CSOAI provides measurement and governance of what agents do inside any runtime. A measurement capsule on OpenShell-confined agent behaviour would be a concrete product demo.
nvidia_openshell.action: Add OpenShell to the Harness X measurement targets. A bounded measurement of agent behaviour under OpenShell confinement would demonstrate the GSPC measurement substrate works on third-party runtimes.

agntcy_identity.name: AGNTCY Identity
agntcy_identity.description: AGNTCY Identity allows to onboard, create and verify identities for Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers and Multi-Agent Systems (MASs).
agntcy_identity.v0_0_26_changes: Signed build provenance for CLI artifacts, OpenPGP security fix, scorecard quick wins
agntcy_identity.csoai_wedge: Measure/adapt only where it improves identity/interop; do not duplicate existing AGNTCY catalog work.
agntcy_identity.csoai_relevance: Medium-high. AGNTCY identity handles agent/MCP/MAS identity — CSOAI's agent-identity-trust MCP does similar work. Interop opportunity: CSOAI measurement capsules could attest to AGNTCY identity verification results.
agntcy_identity.action: Evaluate AGNTCY identity v0.0.26 signed build provenance for interop with CSOAI's SIGIL attestation. Do not duplicate — interoperate.

lfdt_proof_of_control.name: LFDT / Advanced AI Society — Proof-of-Control
lfdt_proof_of_control.description: The Proof-of-Control Standard (PoC) is a catalogue of verifiable requirements for AI agent systems: independent, tamper-evident evidence of what an agent actually did — the data it touched, the authority it exercised, the tools it invoked — in a form anyone can check without trusting the operator.
lfdt_proof_of_control.csoai_relevance: Very high. The PoC standard's goals align directly with CSOAI's SIGIL hash-chain audit + GSPC measurement substrate. CSOAI could be the independent conformance/reproduction instrument that tests whether an agent system meets PoC requirements.
lfdt_proof_of_control.action: Study the PoC standard catalogue. Identify which requirements CSOAI's existing measurement capsules can already verify. Position CSOAI as the conformance instrument for PoC — measure, never certify.

cross_cutting_themes: Agent runtime governance is converging (NVIDIA OpenShell, AGNTCY, LFDT PoC). CSOAI's gap-to-fill: independent measurement and conformance, not another runtime.
Identity + provenance + attestation (AGNTCY signed provenance, PoC tamper-evident evidence) maps to CSOAI's SIGIL + Ed25519 + GSPC measurement capsules.
None of these have adopted CSOAI. Do not describe any as having adopted GSPC.
honesty_note: External research from GitHub API + public URLs. No partnerships, endorsements, or integrations claimed. Stars/counts are point-in-time observations. CSOAI wedge assessments are proposals, not established positions.
